items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-26
items.q: Now we have, in this band, Robinson, Stillworth, Shields, Bara, Christian, and myself.

ctx.x: I'm sorry, I didn't get anything about the trombone player.

Oh, yes. Edwards was drafted around, in the middle, almost in fall. We came to New Orleans to get a trombone player. Emil played connet. He had been with several bands up to Chicago. And they were unsuccessful. He came back to New Orleans to play. And when we came back here to look for a trombone player, Spobora met Emil and told him, ask him if he knew a good trombone player. He said, well, how about give me a chance? Emil had started to change it to trombone. He said, all right. We went to Shields' house.…
Did he make any records in this country with him, Emil?
